name: raptr-names
description: Name a business, product or project, and check the domains and GitHub name are free.

interface.shortDescription: Name it, then own the name
interface.longDescription:
Starting a business, a side hustle, an app or a podcast? Raptr Names brainstorms names with you and checks, for each one, which domains are actually free (.com, .co, .ai, .io and .app by default, or any endings you choose) and whether the GitHub name is free.

It checks up to 8 names at a time, ranks them (a free .com counts most), shows the price of each free domain including the first term, and keeps suggesting new options until you have a name you can really own.

Checking is free and needs no account. Nothing you search for is stored.
capabilities: Brainstorm business, product and project names
Check which domains are free for each name, with prices
Check whether the GitHub name is free
Rank names so the ones you can fully own come first
Explain how to register the domain you pick
defaultPrompt: Help me name my bakery and check the domains
I'm starting a dog-walking business in Atlanta, what should I call it?
Find a name for my AI startup with a free .com

positive.prompt: Help me name my bakery and check which domains are free.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests several names, checks them in one call, and lists free domains with prices and GitHub status, best first.

positive.prompt: Check these names: Rise and Crumb, Northwind Bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks the two names with their free domains (with prices) and GitHub name status.

positive.prompt: I want a .shop domain for my candle store. Suggest names and check them.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the suggested names with the .shop ending (and others if asked) and reports which are free.

positive.prompt: Is 'google' available as a business name with a .com?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports google.com as taken and suggests and checks alternatives.

positive.prompt: I picked northwindbakery.com. How do I get it?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains how to register it; nothing is bought.

negative.description: Trademark legal advice is out of scope
